_about: Embraer EMB-145XR (ERJ-145XR), from Embraer's Airport Planning Manual APM-145/1100, Revision 16 (Nov 29/24): 2.2 Airplane Dimensions (page index 17-18: span 21.00 m, the rest as the EMB-145's), Figure 2.2.2 EMB-145XR Airplane General Dimensions (page index 20), Figure 2.7.1 Door Clearances (page index 32-33, for all the EMB-145s). Figure 2.2.2 is drawn at 0.910 of Figure 2.2.1's scale: rendered at 17.588 (16 / 0.9097, from the two figures' nose-to-tail extents, both 29.87 m) so its rasters lie on the EMB-145's; laid over each other they differ only at the winglets, the ventral strakes under the tail cone (not modelled) and a nose antenna. The EMB-145's placed points (e145/) moved onto these rasters (plug.py with no plugs: --shift 4,23 side, 33,168 plan, 258,129 front) and snapped; the winglet placed here. The EMB-145's references, doors and cockpit panes moved by the same shift. Scaled by the printed 27.93 m fuselage length. A T-tail with two AE 3007A1E nacelles on stub pylons on the rear fuselage, winglets. Doors and windows as the EMB-145's (Figure 2.7.1 serves all the models). One window is crossed by the winglet's lines (windowsAlso). After smooth.py, tipmeet.py starts the winglet on the wing's tip (docs/SHAPES.md: the side drawing's winglet leaves the wing 0.5 m behind the tip's leading edge, where the front view's bend hides it).

sources.title: Embraer, EMB-145 Airport Planning Manual (APM-145/1100, Revision 16, Nov 29/24), 2.2 Airplane Dimensions, Figure 2.2.2 EMB-145XR Airplane General Dimensions, Figure 2.7.1 Door Clearances
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off Figure 2.2.2's side, plan and front views, drawn at 0.910 of Figure 2.2.1's scale and evened out to it (tools/trace/e45x/: the EMB-145's points moved onto it and snapped, the winglets placed here); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The ventral strakes under the tail cone aren't in the shape. The right side's service door is placed from Figure 2.7.1 as on the EMB-145.
